import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd
import sys

url = 'http://server:8000'
response = requests.get(url)
if response.status_code != 200:
    print(f'Failed to fetch {url}: {response.status_code}')
    sys.exit(1)

soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
books = []
for book in soup.find_all('div', class_='book'):
    title = book.find('div', class_='book-title').text.strip()
    author = book.find('div', class_='book-author').text.strip()
    year = book.find('span', class_='book-year').text.strip()
    rating = book.find('span', class_='book-rating').text.strip()
    price = book.find('span', class_='book-price').text.strip()
    # Clean price: remove '$' and commas
    price = price.replace('$', '').replace(',', '')
    # Clean rating: split by '/'
    rating = float(rating.split('/')[0])
    year = int(year.split(': ')[1]) if ': ' in year else int(year)
    books.append({
        'title': title,
        'author': author,
        'year': year,
        'rating': rating,
        'price': price
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(books, columns=['title', 'author', 'year', 'rating', 'price'])
df.to_csv('books.csv', index=False)

# Summary report
total = len(books)
avg_price = df['price'].mean()
highest_rated = df.loc[df['rating'].idxmax()]
with open('report.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f'Total books: {total}\n')
    f.write(f'Average price: {avg_price:.2f}\n')
    f.write(f'Highest rated book: {highest_rated["title"]} by {highest_rated["author"]} ({highest_rated["rating"]}/5)\n')

print('Done')
EOF
